headline: The pipeline you rent is shrinking. Ours — the one we own — is compounding.
read: Two reads collide this week. Externally, the money cluster's central villain is visibly cracking: Angi's fiscal 2025 revenue fell 13% to $1.03B, its shared-lead 'network' engine collapsed 79% after the January-2025 homeowner-choice change, and it cut ~350 jobs — yet it got MORE profitable (adjusted EBITDA +25%), which means it's squeezing the pros still on it harder. That's a gift for our positioning and I turned it into a new post today. Internally, the picture is unchanged from Monday: the paid engine works (~13.5k video views, 9.4k reach, $68 spend), organic is still cold (3 FB followers, 17 engagement), and the gap is conversion, not production — 95 items in the syndication queue, 108 FB posts and 8 reels still loaded. We are not thin on content; we're thin on asks-to-follow against a warm-viewer pool that's just sitting there.
next_move: Convert and compound. (1) Highest leverage: stand up the retarget→Page-Like/Follow ad against the 25/50/95% video-watchers we've already paid to build — that pool is idle and it's the single cheapest follower we'll ever buy. (2) Reels format pivot: 2026 short-form data says problem/fix walkthroughs, before/afters, and founder-visibility 30-60s clips with BURNED-IN word-level captions are what's landing — reweight the reel queue toward that and away from pure gag reels; confirm captions are burned in, not auto. (3) Keep the money cluster compounding — next posts: the Jan-2025 'homeowner choice' change and what it did to lead quality, and the Thumbtack BBB/chargeback-deactivation scam-cluster piece (flagged twice, still unwritten). (4) Still zero real named contractor quotes in the inbox (only IG spam) — keep /share-your-story/ + FB prompts running for phase-2 EEAT. Posts-shipped target right-sized 90→60 to match the real FB cadence.
